04Case studies

Methods in, evidence out.

Each study follows the same path: M&E methods collect the data, analysis interprets it, and triangulated findings lead to an outcome.

International labour-rights organisation · Baseline study

Child labour baseline assessment

Baseline for floriculture supply chains supplying essence extraction across 15 villages in 5 districts, covering child protection, agricultural productivity, wages and grievance mechanisms, and occupational safety.

1M&E methods

KIIs and SSIs with farmers, workers, school staff and officials, FGDs with communities, and a 900-respondent survey captured through Survey Speaks.

KIISSIFGDSurvey

2Analysis

Quantitative analysis by theme and village, thematic coding of interviews, and benchmarking against ASER 2024 education data.

ExcelSQLPower BIThematic coding

3Key findings

Child involvement in harvesting60%
Spraying without protective kit55%
Paid below statutory wage30%

4Outcome

LFA + ToC

Findings structured into an LFA and Theory of Change, shaping interventions in child protection, health, livelihoods, safe chemical use and youth skills.

District government partnership · CSR-funded

Bonded labour and education transition

Village-level assessment of bonded labour households in two districts, covering wages against statutory rates, working conditions, safety, health and child involvement.

1M&E methods

Household survey through Survey Speaks in every village, KIIs with district officials, and FGDs with families and employers.

SurveyKIIFGD

2Analysis

District-level disaggregation, wages and working hours compared with statutory norms, and safety and health risk analysis.

ExcelPower BIDisaggregation

3Key findings

Ranipet: children working, 15945%
Chengalpattu: children working, 22040%
Workers facing safety risks80%

4Outcome

379

Children enrolled in government schools through CSR-funded transit schools, with an SROI of 1 : 2.

Real-time CSR impact dashboard

A live Power BI dashboard giving the donor continuous visibility of progress against timeline, with audit-ready impact and financial reporting.

Power BIDAXSROI

A comparative study of physical activity, sleep and heart-rate patterns using Fitbit data from two communities.

Fitbitn = 402 groups

Participants40
